messages:
Anya: dropped a compact mock for the capacity editor. goal: show min/max + burst in one row for mobile while keeping cost visible. thoughts?
Jess: looks promising. main copy nit: `Burst` -> `Burst (temporary)` and add tiny duration choices (10m / 30m / 1h). avoids confusion with reserved.
Mike: agree on duration. also move numeric cost estimate to the right of the row so it doesn't overlap label on small widths. tone down sparkline contrast.
Ben: backend note: 10m = fast-evict spots, 1h may fall back to reserved. will publish exact supported durations.
Sam: a11y: slider announces value but not guardrail state. add aria-live region that says e.g. "Min exceeds recommended capacity". keyboard steps: arrow=1, shift+arrow=5, pageup/pagedown=10.
Anya: UI affordance: pool tiles should show "shared/dedicated" badge + GPU family tag. clickable whole tile.
Jess: override flow: if min > pool cap show inline message with two buttons: "Save anyway" and "Adjust to recommendation". don't use modal unless user clicks more info.
Mike: contrast nit: the small muted text fails AA at 12px. bump weight or darken 12-15%.
design-bot: mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/compact-capacity-editor - frame: "Compact-row-v1"
Anya: action items: Jess will update microcopy, Sam will add aria snippets, Ben will send durations, Mike will tweak contrast and cost placement. reconvene tomorrow for a quick sweep. :thumbsup:
